embeddings.text: Undergraduate students with a grade point average of at least 88 in the previous academic year are eligible for an excellence scholarship of 6,000 ILS.
Students must have completed at least 30 credit points in the previous year.
Students whose household income per person is below 3,500 ILS per month receive an additional need supplement of 3,000 ILS.
Students with a serious disciplinary record in the last two years are not eligible.
Students in their final year who have an average of 85 to 87.9 are referred to the scholarship committee.
Graduate students are not covered by this policy and are rejected.
Students with an average of at least 85 are eligible for the excellence scholarship.
Applications that meet the conditions above are approved. Applications not decided by the rules above are referred to the scholarship committee.

R-010 · Excellence scholarship of 6,000
When: gpa ≥ 88
Then: set scholarship_amount = 6,000
Source, paragraph 1: "are eligible for an excellence scholarship of 6,000 ILS"

R-020 · Need supplement of 3,000
When: gpa ≥ 88 AND income_per_person < 3,500 ILS
Then: set scholarship_amount = scholarship_amount + 3,000
Source, paragraph 3: "Students whose household income per person is below 3,500 ILS per month receive an additional need supplement of 3,000 ILS"

R-100 · Reject: graduate students
When: degree ≠ bachelor
Then: reject: Graduate students are not covered by this policy
Source, paragraph 6: "Graduate students are not covered by this policy and are rejected"

R-110 · Reject: disciplinary record
When: disciplinary_record = true
Then: reject: A disciplinary record in the last two years removes eligibility
Source, paragraph 4: "Students with a serious disciplinary record in the last two years are not eligible"

R-120 · Reject: fewer than 30 credit points
When: credits < 30
Then: reject: At least 30 credit points in the previous year are required
Source, paragraph 2: "Students must have completed at least 30 credit points in the previous year"

R-130 · Reject: average below 85
When: gpa < 85
Then: reject: An average below 85 is not eligible and not referred
Source, paragraph 5: "an average of 85 to 87.9"

R-140 · Reject: average 85 to 87.9 outside the final year
When: gpa < 88 AND final_year = false
Then: reject: An average below 88 is referred only in the final year
Source, paragraph 1: "a grade point average of at least 88 in the previous academic year"

R-300 · Committee: final-year student with an average of 85 to 87.9
When: gpa < 88
Then: refer: A final-year student with an average of 85 to 87.9 is referred to the scholarship committee
Source, paragraph 5: "Students in their final year who have an average of 85 to 87.9 are referred to the scholarship committee"

R-900 · Approve the scholarship
When: always
Then: approve: The student meets the excellence scholarship conditions
Source, paragraph 8: "Applications that meet the conditions above are approved"
